subsystem: Apple Video Encoder 2 (AVE2) Hardware Command Queue Protocol

ProcessCmd_Open.role: Allocates new hardware encoder session context and reserves DPB frames
ProcessCmd_Open.parameters: SessionID, CodecType (AV1, HEVC, AVC, ProRes), FrameWidth, FrameHeight, Profile, Tier

ProcessCmd_Close.role: Terminates active encoder session, flushes DMA pipelines, releases DPB memory

ProcessCmd_Start.role: Transitions session to active encoding state and initializes clock mesh

ProcessCmd_Start_AVC.role: Initializes AVC/H.264 hardware pipeline, loads CAVLC/CABAC tables

ProcessCmd_Start_HEVC.role: Initializes HEVC hardware pipeline, sets up CTU 64x64/32x32 grids

ProcessCmd_Process_AVC.role: Submits frame encode job for AVC/H.264 stream

ProcessCmd_Process_HEVC.role: Submits frame encode job for HEVC/H.265 stream
ProcessCmd_Process_HEVC.parameters: sCmdInformation pointer, SourceDMA, BitstreamDMA, SliceParams, RPS

ProcessCmd_Process_LRME.role: Executes low-resolution motion estimation pass across downsampled luma

ProcessCmd_Process_MCTF.role: Executes motion-compensated temporal filtering denoising pass

ProcessCmd_Process_DMV.role: Executes dense motion vector quarter-pel refinement pass

ProcessCmd_Process_GGM.role: Computes global affine camera motion parameters across consecutive frames

ProcessCmd_Config.role: Dynamically reconfigures bitrate, frame rate, GOP structure, or ROI matrices

ProcessCmd_Flush.role: Forces immediate completion and bitstream writeout of all in-flight frames

ProcessCmd_Reset.role: Resets hardware encoder pipeline registers following unrecoverable bus faults

ProcessCmd_Priority.role: Modifies stream arbitration priority within CAVEPriorityQueue

ProcessCmd_Complete.role: Signals completion of encoding job, writes back status header, raises doorbell

ipc_routines.name: _os_mailbox_queue_init
ipc_routines.role: Allocates mailbox ring buffer and initializes head/tail pointers

ipc_routines.name: _os_mailbox_queue_send
ipc_routines.role: Host deposits 64-byte command descriptor and asserts doorbell

ipc_routines.name: _os_mailbox_queue_receivew
ipc_routines.role: Coprocessor thread blocks waiting for doorbell event

ipc_routines.name: _os_mailbox_queue_destroy
ipc_routines.role: Deallocates mailbox ring buffer and clears interrupt bindings

arbitration.scheduling_policy: Deficit Weighted Round Robin (DWRR) with Real-Time Video Preemption
